function: The DRL agent (EPPO) learns only the UAV flight displacement; IRS phase shifts come from closed-form Eq. 15, so the learning acts on UAV trajectory, above the physical layer (p. 8).
notes: Excluded as above_phy. The title and abstract say 'jointly optimizing phase shifts of the IRS and UAV trajectory', but the learned policy outputs only a_t = {a^x, a^y, a^z}, the UAV flight distances (p. 6, Sec. 4.1.2; p. 8, Algorithm 1 line 8). The phase shifts are computed in closed form from coordinates by Eq. 15, which reduces 'the original action space of (Mr x Mc + 3) ... to 3' (p. 8, Sec. 4.3.3). Page 10: 'while the benchmark algorithms need to learn IRS phase shifts, EPPO does not require this phase shift learning process'. So no physical-layer decision is learned jointly with the trajectory. Judgement call for the reviewer: if the joint problem is read as a learned RIS configuration, the work would be area 3 (single-antenna SU, UAV-carried reflecting IRS, mmWave, custom Rician channel, pp. 4-5). PDF is arXiv:2501.02787v1, a preprint; its title was not checked against the DOI record.
